projects.title: Insurance Onboarding Tool
projects.description:
Web application made with the intention of being a temporary way for insurance agents to onboard their clients to a telematics program while the company is integrating Arity's endpoints into their own services.  The onboarding tool was the first full-stack project owned by Driving Insights. 
Tools Used: 
     Front-End: React.JS, HTML, CSS, JEST
     Back-End:  Java, Spring, JUnit 4, SolR, Cassandra
     Misc.: Jenkins, Github, Git, DataStax
